messages.subject: [dsiaffiliates][D-RUG] Sacramento Women in Data meeting: talks on R (ggplot), Python, and preventing wildfires using data science
parts:
Hello all,

I just wanted to share another exciting Women in Data meeting coming up on next Wednesday (May 15th) from 7-9 PM at the Urban Hive in Sacramento (1601 Alhambra Blvd #100, Sacramento, CA). The talks will include:

Indu Shali: "Overview of a Data Science Project Workflow (using Python)"
Emily Merchant: "ggplot Part 2"
Amin Ghaderi: "Decreasing wildlife fire due to transmission line misoperation using data science"

If planning on attending, RSVP on meetup:
https://www.meetup.com/Sacramento-Women-in-Data/events/260166687/  

Women in Data (WID) is a national non-profit organization aimed at increasing diversity in data careers. Click here to check out more on Women in Data.

Best,
Hanna Kahl
Chapter Lead - Women in Data
